basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old automotive technician living in the Pacific Northwest. My interests include working on Dodge cars, experimenting with new dab rigs, and managing my type 1 diabetes. I'm usually online late at night after my shifts at the garage. I'm currently single and I spend most of my weekends attending car meets or trying out new cannabis strains. I enjoy learning about technology that can help me manage my health better.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of automotive mechanics, particularly Dodge vehicles, thanks to my years of experience as a technician. My interest in technology, especially related to diabetes management, is driven by necessity and a desire to optimize my health. I've self-taught myself about various diabetes technologies and actively seek out online resources and community insights.
